title: Oxford shirt
description: A white long-sleeved button-down shirt with a pointed collar and chest pocket.
descriptionZh: 白色長袖排釦襯衫，尖領、單邊胸袋與弧形下襬。
prompt: White cotton Oxford shirt, pointed button-down collar, long sleeves, left chest pocket, curved hem.

title: Navy jacket
description: A navy single-breasted jacket with notched lapels and two buttons.
descriptionZh: 海軍藍單排雙釦西裝外套，平駁領、兩側翻蓋口袋。
prompt: Navy tailored single-breasted blazer, notched lapels, two dark buttons, flap pockets, long sleeves.

title: Midi dress
description: A terracotta sleeveless midi dress with a round neckline and softly flared skirt.
descriptionZh: 陶土色無袖中長洋裝，圓領、收腰與微展裙襬。
prompt: Terracotta sleeveless midi dress, round neckline, fitted waist, softly flared A-line skirt, matte woven fabric.

title: Relaxed front
description: Face the camera with relaxed arms and the weight resting on one leg.
descriptionZh: 正面看向鏡頭，雙臂自然垂放，重心落在單腳。
prompt: Full-body front-facing pose, relaxed arms beside the body, weight on the right leg, left foot slightly forward.

title: Hand on hip
description: Stand at a slight angle with one hand on the hip and the other arm relaxed.
descriptionZh: 身體微側，一手叉腰，另一隻手自然垂放。
prompt: Full-body three-quarter standing pose, right hand on hip with elbow out, left arm relaxed, feet apart.

title: Seated profile
description: Sit sideways on a stool with both feet on the floor and hands resting on the knees.
descriptionZh: 側身坐在高腳凳上，雙腳落地，雙手輕放膝上。
prompt: Full-body seated side profile on a simple stool, torso upright, knees bent, both feet on floor, hands resting on knees.

title: Window light
description: Broad soft light from the left with gentle shadow on the opposite side.
descriptionZh: 左側大面積柔光，另一側保留柔和陰影。
prompt: Soft diffused daylight from a large window on camera left, gentle facial shadows, natural neutral white balance.

title: Warm rim light
description: Warm light from behind the right shoulder with a soft neutral fill on the face.
descriptionZh: 右後方暖光勾出輪廓，臉部以中性柔光補亮。
prompt: Warm golden rim light from behind camera right outlining hair and shoulders, soft neutral frontal fill, controlled exposure.
